assessments.assessment: WF3 one schema-only miner followed by one exact-sum or schema-only solver. Frozen attachment includes raw hash and source-pointer provenance; solver preserves original objective/input while adding digest-bound guidance. Digit filtering is lexical, not semantic answer exclusion. Four L2 public-binding fields are fixed by schema, so the source explicitly disclaims learned grounding; mined signature overlap is not learning. Mining arity actually bounded0..8 by oneOf despite outer128.

Optional historical miner reuse compares raw/manifest hashes without authenticating provider origin. dispatch_phase validates only one gateway at a time plus limit/max_calls, unlike WF5 full run/path/objective binding; possible injected factory can supply distinct phase ledgers. This remains candidate source-level budget gap pending focused probe.
